confidence_notes: Overall medium. Inexpensive meal, coffee and beer rest on several Busan-specific aggregator figures that broadly agree, though some are dated (2021-2023 pages) or based on few data points. Cocktail uses a Busan bar-guide price range. No verified Busan wine-by-the-glass price was found, so wine_glass is about 2.3 times the beer anchor (local price relationship). The mid-range meal for two rests mainly on one aggregator figure. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not checked against listings. Won figures converted at roughly 1,440 KRW per USD (no live KRW rate verified). FX value is the latest RBA observation found (18 Nov 2026), read from a search-result summary of the RBA table; no 19 Nov value was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Busan-specific figures for meals, coffee, beer and cocktails; Seoul was only a reference point because sources disagree on how Busan compares with it. Wine is derived from beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Korean port city in summer peak season, not a named comparable city.
